notes: Right/left-hand punch (side picked by bag y) with feet planted and CoM feedback; 20/20 seeds succeed on the practice bag (0.38,-0.15,1.0), swing 34-39 cm, max tilt ~4 deg. Not robust beyond that: bags at z<=0.7 or far (x>=0.45) often fail, and 5 ad-hoc low bags (z 0.3-0.4, not counted in the rate) all failed with falls or no hit, since there is no foot kick.
